scope: Only the four assigned PW settings reference pairs in reference-12; eight original PNGs were individually viewed.
comparison_scale: Candidate logical 1x at 618 by 824; reference physical 2x at 1236 by 1648; compare one reference logical pixel to two physical pixels.

identity.capture_method: native Slint application --capture; unmodified original PNG

observations: The original 618 by 824 candidate PNG and 1236 by 1648 reference PNG were viewed individually and compared at the same logical scale.

The device card, four Kindle device rows, and three reading rows preserve the reference grouping, horizontal gutters, approximately 52 logical pixel list rows, and right-aligned values. All seven rows are visible without clipping.
The serif settings heading and device title, black text, neutral gray secondary text, fine separators, first-page folio, next-page affordance, and active settings dock match the reference hierarchy.
intentional_differences: The actual application version 0.1.0 replaces the reference version placeholder.
The image-processing summary explicitly describes software sixteen-level grayscale dithering rather than using the shorter reference sample summary.

identity.capture_method: native Slint application --capture; unmodified original PNG

observations: The back label, approximately 30/38 logical pixel serif heading, 22 logical pixel horizontal content gutters, five refresh intervals, and three quality cards follow the reference composition.
Quality selection is visibly unavailable and all three quality cards use a consistent disabled treatment, rather than suggesting a qualified hardware refresh mode.

The three switch rows and the complete sixteen-cell black-to-white test strip remain visible. The test strip has a continuous outer outline, including the final white cell and its right edge; the previously described open-border symptom is not visible in this PW capture.
There is no list pager on this detail page. The dock is present in both this actual PW reference PNG and the candidate, so it is not counted as a mismatch.
intentional_differences: The unavailable quality selector and chapter-refresh switch disclose the desktop capture capability boundary.
The close-menu cleanup preference is enabled in the captured application state, while the reference sample toggle is off. Its label describes residual-image cleanup.

identity.capture_method: native Slint application --capture; unmodified original PNG

observations: The second list page correctly omits the device card and shows nine rows in groups of two, four, and three. The group labels, row separators, and final about row remain visible above the pager.
The previous-page control and final 2/2 folio match the reference. No next-page affordance is shown on the final page, and the settings dock retains its selected state.
The heading, list typography, neutral gray values, approximately 52 logical pixel row rhythm, and horizontal row alignment closely follow the reference without visible clipping or overlap.
intentional_differences: Current application values replace reference sample data: zero installed sources, nine downloads, unconfigured tracking, and version 0.1.0.
Unimplemented automatic-update, backup, and diagnostic-export entries explicitly report unavailable rather than displaying the reference sample feature summaries.

identity.capture_method: native Slint application --capture; unmodified original PNG

observations: The back label and serif heading follow the reference, and the three policy rows share the reference logical anchors: the first row starts near y130 and their three 54 pixel rows end near y292.

The three screensaver cards retain the reference horizontal gutters, approximately 183 logical pixel widths, 150 logical pixel heights, and 12 logical pixel inter-card gaps. The exit card and its black button are fully visible and are not obscured by the dock.

The screensaver preview grid begins near logical y346 in the candidate, compared with about y337.5 in the reference. Because the policy divider and preview card heights match, this is a localized excess gap of about 8.5 logical pixels, rather than a whole-image scale change.
The reference prototype explicitly uses main gap 10px, policy min-height 54px, and a 12px screensaver label with margin-top 8px. These tokens substantiate the localized spacing finding.
There is no list pager on this detail page. The dock is present in the matching PW reference PNG and candidate.
intentional_differences: Charging update, Wi-Fi power policy, and screensaver selection use unavailable disabled presentations for the desktop capture capability boundary.

The disabled previews do not reproduce handoff sample artwork or chapter progress. The sidecar reports no loaded covers and no current chapter, so sample artwork and progress are not required as actual application values.

suggestions.description: Reduce the excess vertical spacing before the PW power screensaver preview grid.

evidence.candidate: The third policy-row divider ends near logical y292, but the preview grid begins near y346 and ends near y496.
evidence.reference: The same divider ends near logical y292; the preview grid begins near y337.5 and ends near y487.5. The approximately 8.5 pixel excess gap carries through to the preview captions and exit card.
evidence.reference_tokens: Power main gap: 10px; policy min-height: 54px; screensaver label font-size: 12px and margin-top: 8px; grid gap: 12px; preview height: 150px; exit card margin-top: 6px.
evidence.assessment: The viewport scale, policy-row anchors, horizontal geometry, and preview heights match. The difference is localized to the heading/gap block between the third policy row and preview grid; all coordinates are approximate visual readings normalized to logical scale.

suggestions.recommendation: Match the reference 10px main gap and 8px label top margin, including the corresponding 12px label line box, so the preview grid starts near logical y338 while retaining the current 150px card heights and horizontal dimensions.

limitations: This review covers only reference-12 and does not establish that the full round is clean.
This is a static PNG and sidecar review. Visibility and absence of clipping are assessed, but live navigation, control behavior, and physical e-ink rendering are not exercised.

The run, binary, and source identities were matched to the case sidecars; the binary and source files themselves were not recomputed. The assigned aggregate reference identity was recorded, while each assigned reference PNG was independently hashed and matched to its sidecar.

No local application, build, tests, validation suite, runtime probe, git command, or product modification was performed. Work was limited to authorized evidence reads, original PNG viewing, SHA256 hashing, the reference power prototype token read, and writing this review JSON.
